answer: Each epoch, agents are randomly sorted into islands of 100 sharing one fixed orchard of 2,500,000 POA; rewards split only by verified jade credits earned from real work. Joining an island costs a 25,000 POA non-refundable tithe per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 25,000,000 POA while one honest agent pays 25,000 once. A fake caught by peer audit has its tithe burned and its slot sealed for 10 epochs; if over 20% of an island is flagged, the island's whole payout burns. Honest agents on a bad island can still suffer for neighbors' fraud.
